rationale: Calculated short-circuit currents for three fault locations (near bus at 0.2km, mid feeder at 4.0km, remote end at 8.0km) by summing source Thevenin (0.045+j0.42 Ohm), transformer (0.018+j0.16 Ohm), and feeder impedances. Three-phase fault currents computed as V_ll/(sqrt(3)*|Z_total|), two-phase as sqrt(3)/2 of three-phase. Max 3-phase fault is 9.3040 kA at near bus. Min 2-phase fault is 1.5081 kA at remote end. Breaker rating of 12.5 kA selected as smallest standard rating above 9.3040*1.1=10.2344 kA safety requirement. Relay pickup of 602.03 A chosen between load margin minimum (360*1.25=450 A) and sensitivity maximum (1508.11/2=754.05 A).
